raw.title: runner: executeAll() for batch (libopenapi-style) semantics
raw.body:
A future \`executeAll()\` is the natural home for libopenapi-style batch semantics — running several workflows of a document in one call, with \`dependsOn\` interpreted across the batch (the interpretation note from the retired plan doc's §5: memoized prerequisites spanning the batch rather than one \`execute\` call each).

**Blocked by:**
- #62 (input channel for reference/transfer-run workflows) — the batch input story should build on, not preempt, the per-target input channels
- #78 (API surface review) — new public API should land on the reviewed surface
